QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Suspicious Surroundings
QuestInfo.0: It seems Corine has finally pulled herself together, and she has a request to make of you. Talk with her and see what it could be.
QuestInfo.1: Corine says she found people destroying the jungle and threatening animals in the jungle's western reaches. Notify Mayor Icebyrd Slimm of this alarming development.
QuestInfo.2: You reported to Mayor Icebyrd Slimm about the exploitative invaders in the jungle.

npc.0: There are people roaming around the jungle and threatening the animals. Relay this information to the mayor of NLC.
